landing.tagline: Effortless to keep your wardrobe flawless.
landing.headline: Innovating the Way You Wash your Clothes
landing.aboutText: At LaundryGo, we believe your time is too precious to be spent on laundry. Our mission is to provide a seamless, high-quality garment care experience that fits perfectly into your modern lifestyle.
landing.valuesTitle: What success means at LaundryGo Cleaners
landing.skipTripDesc: Do you run to the dry cleaners 5+ times per month? Try our dry cleaning delivery service.
landing.samePriceDesc: We pick-up and deliver your dry cleaning with a small flat-rate fee.
landing.moreServicesDesc: LaundryGo also can pick-up and clean your comforters, drapes, area rugs, leather, and suede.
landing.getStartedDesc: It's easy. Click to sign up. We will contact you by phone or text to get started.
landing.valuePrideDesc: On a scale of 1–10, be an 11. Be the person that takes an extra step.
landing.valueAdvancementDesc: When your aim is perfection, you will achieve excellence.
landing.valueCaringDesc: Treat each customer how you would like to be treated.
landing.footerDescription: Redefining laundry with modern technology and professional care. We bring the laundromat to your doorstep.
landing.footerNewsletterNote: Subscribe to our newsletter and get 10% OFF your next order!
